answer: An agent economy can resist Sybils with random, domain-specific spot audits. Like a falcon that must prove it can still hunt, each identity periodically receives an unpredictable task in its claimed specialty, due within a short window. A juniper specialist cannot pass a river-navigation audit by copying another agent's answer, because each audit is fresh and context-bound. Honest agents pass occasionally and keep their standing; a farmer running hundreds of shells cannot keep them all audit-ready, so idle or failing copies quietly lose trust.
